execution: Serial seed campaigns on the same physical GPU; each launch rechecks resources. Start seed1 after the earlier matrix and all40 smoke terminate successfully.
selection_basis: Two prespecified seed0 learning rates; lr2e-5 had stronger full-clip physical performance at iteration1000 across three evaluation repeats. Development costs are separate; no claim of globally optimal PPO tuning.

primary_endpoint.rule: First observed checkpoint whose mean of three complete physical evaluations satisfies both; never interpolate or extrapolate

censoring: Report attainment numerator/denominator and per-seed cost; if any seed fails to reach a target, do not report an uncensored mean time or an invented speedup.
costs: All model data collection, fitting, policy optimization, cold setup, checkpoint IO and physical repeats charged. Every standalone frozen method pays the full shared pretrain cost; actual campaign spend deduplicates it.
scope_limit: 4000 iterations are a finite comparison budget, not a convergence guarantee. All40 is a separate cohort with new qualification and forecast; never pool its returns or GPU costs with locomotion.
gradient_followup: After physical evaluations: per-seed final SuperMimic collector, shared bank across WM1000/2000/3000/4000, full/state_only H1/8/32, eps .003/.01/.03/.1. Report state-level dependency and resolved fractions. H32 stable-contact counts may be too small; do not claim significance from them.
